l4_steps.name: Pull premium passenger manifest from Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Flight departure schedule T-24h; SSR codes VIPS, MAAS, EXST
l4_steps.output: Confirmed VIP/CIP passenger list with PNRs and service flags
l4_steps.kpi: VIP list generated ≥3h before STD for 100% of flagged flights
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa SSR codes not consistently populated by booking agents; last-minute upgrades bypass VIP workflow trigger, causing missed service setup

l4_steps.name: Verify VIP profile, entitlements and SSRs in CRM
l4_steps.input: PNR list and SSR flags from Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Verified VIP tier, lounge entitlement, dietary/mobility needs, escort preferences
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of flagged passengers have CRM profiles verified ≥2h before STD
l4_steps.pain_point: CRM–PSS integration is batch-updated every 30 min; loyalty tier upgrades post-booking are not reflected in CRM until next sync cycle, causing entitlement disputes at lounge

l4_steps.name: Assign dedicated escort agent and ground transport
l4_steps.input: Verified VIP list, staff roster, buggy and vehicle availability in AMS
l4_steps.output: Named escort assignments and ground transport booking confirmations
l4_steps.kpi: Dedicated escort assigned ≥2h before STD for 95% of VIP departures
l4_steps.pain_point: High-volume departure banks create escort staff shortages; SITA AMS staff-allocation module is not integrated with VIP workflow, requiring manual cross-referencing

l4_steps.name: Deploy escort agent to kerb or designated arrival point
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS (mobile boarding agent app)
l4_steps.input: VIP manifest, expected arrival time, ground transport ETA
l4_steps.output: Escort agent positioned at correct terminal entry with passenger itinerary loaded
l4_steps.kpi: Escort on-station ≥15 min before passenger arrival for 95% of VIP movements
l4_steps.pain_point: No real-time kerb vehicle arrival feed from ground transport into Altéa mobile app; agents rely on manual WhatsApp coordination, introducing timing errors

l4_steps.name: Confirm passenger identity and validate service entitlement
l4_steps.input: Passenger boarding pass, frequent flyer card or government-issued ID
l4_steps.output: Identity confirmed, service tier validated, escort commences
l4_steps.kpi: Identity verification completed within 2 min of passenger contact; 100% compliance rate
l4_steps.pain_point: Offline CRM access unreliable in terminals with poor Wi-Fi coverage; agents revert to static printed lists containing stale tier and entitlement data

l4_steps.name: Escort passenger through fast-track security and immigration
l4_steps.system: Airport Authority Fast-Track Access System (TSA/CBP portal or equivalent)
l4_steps.input: Confirmed identity, valid boarding pass, fast-track access credentials
l4_steps.output: Passenger cleared security and immigration, escorted airside
l4_steps.kpi: Fast-track clearance time ≤15 min for 90% of VIP passengers
l4_steps.pain_point: Fast-track lane access controlled by third-party airport authority; VIP agents have no influence over TSA/CBP staffing levels; clearance times spike during IRROP events with no advance warning to escort team

l4_steps.name: Validate lounge entitlement and execute lounge access
l4_steps.input: Verified VIP tier, flight PNR, loyalty programme status
l4_steps.output: Lounge access granted and logged; passenger introduced to lounge host
l4_steps.kpi: Lounge access processing time ≤3 min for 95% of eligible passengers
l4_steps.pain_point: LoungeKey API is batch-synced with PSS; real-time upgrades at check-in are not reflected in lounge access rights until next sync, generating incorrect denials and reputational risk

l4_steps.name: Coordinate ground transport, buggy or mobility service
l4_steps.input: Gate assignment, STD, passenger mobility requirements from CRM
l4_steps.output: Ground buggy or wheelchair dispatched with confirmed pickup time
l4_steps.kpi: Transport dispatched ≥25 min before STD for 95% of requested VIP movements
l4_steps.pain_point: AMS ground transport module is not linked to lounge host workstations; lounge staff must radio ramp operations manually, introducing dispatch delays of 5–12 min during peak periods

l4_steps.name: Monitor flight status and trigger lounge departure alert
l4_steps.system: SITA Airport Management System (AMS) + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Real-time departure board, gate change notifications from AMS
l4_steps.output: Departure alert issued to VIP passenger; escort confirmed at lounge door
l4_steps.kpi: Departure alert issued ≥30 min before STD for 98% of VIP departures; gate change communicated within 5 min of AMS notification
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate change notifications from AMS to lounge management system carry up to 8-min latency; during high-disruption periods VIP passengers have missed boarding calls due to undelivered gate change alerts

l4_steps.name: Set up priority boarding lane and verify gate readiness
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS (check-in and boarding module)
l4_steps.input: VIP passenger list, boarding call time, confirmed gate assignment
l4_steps.output: Priority boarding lane activated; VIP seat blocking released in Altéa
l4_steps.kpi: Priority lane ready ≥20 min before boarding call for 100% of VIP-flagged flights
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate agent allocation is driven by generic staffing schedule; premium lane setup requires a manual Altéa query for VIP passenger count — awareness is not pushed to gate agents automatically

l4_steps.name: Pre-board VIP passenger and brief cabin crew on preferences
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS (boarding scan) + Jeppesen FliteDeck (EFB ground message)
l4_steps.input: Boarding pass, VIP escorted to gate, CRM preference profile
l4_steps.output: Boarding scanned in Altéa; cabin crew briefed via FliteDeck; amenity kit pre-positioned
l4_steps.kpi: VIP pre-board completed ≥10 min before general boarding opens for 95% of applicable flights
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated CRM-to-EFB passenger profile push; escort agent must verbally relay preferences or hand-carry printed notes, creating transcription errors and missed dietary or seating requirements

l4_steps.name: Confirm VIP baggage priority-tagged and loaded in hold
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS (bag reconciliation) + SITA Baggage Reconciliation System (BRS)
l4_steps.input: VIP bag tags from check-in, ULD load plan from weight and balance system
l4_steps.output: Priority bags confirmed loaded and reconciled in SITA BRS before door close
l4_steps.kpi: VIP baggage reconciliation complete ≥10 min before aircraft door close for 100% of bags
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA BRS priority flag requires a manual scan override by ramp agent; automated priority sequencing is not enforced by baggage handling systems at most outstations, defaulting to FIFO load order

l4_steps.name: Confirm VIP boarding complete before general boarding opens
l4_steps.input: Boarding scan records, VIP count from pre-departure list
l4_steps.output: Gate agent confirmation that all VIPs are boarded; general boarding lane opened
l4_steps.kpi: VIP boarding window closed ≥5 min before general boarding for 95% of flights
l4_steps.pain_point: Tight turnaround schedules (<35 min ground time) compress the pre-board window; gate agents under pressure to open general boarding early, bypassing the VIP exclusivity window

l4_steps.name: Detect VIP disruption and escalate for priority recovery
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS + SITA Airport Management System (AMS)
l4_steps.input: Flight cancellation or delay ≥60 min notification from AMS/NOC feed
l4_steps.output: VIP disruption flag raised; supervisor notified; recovery workflow initiated
l4_steps.kpi: VIP disruption detected and escalated within 10 min of AMS notification for 100% of affected flights
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa IRROP rebooking tool does not auto-surface VIP tier during mass disruption; disrupted VIP passengers are queued alongside general passengers with no proactive priority identification

l4_steps.name: Rebook VIP and arrange priority hotel or lounge extension
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa PSS + Salesforce Service Cloud
l4_steps.input: Disrupted VIP passenger list, next-available flight inventory, hotel inventory feed
l4_steps.output: Confirmed rebooking on next available flight; hotel or lounge extension voucher issued
l4_steps.kpi: VIP rebooking offered within 20 min of disruption notification for 95% of affected passengers
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel inventory access from Altéa IRROP module is limited to contracted properties; premium passengers expecting 5-star accommodation must be manually booked outside PSS, adding 15–30 min to recovery time

l4_steps.name: Log service delivery notes and quality score in CRM
l4_steps.input: Completed service checklist, passenger feedback, any complaints or deviations noted during escort
l4_steps.output: CRM record updated with service quality score, issues flagged for relationship manager follow-up
l4_steps.kpi: CRM updated for 100% of VIP interactions within 2h of flight departure
l4_steps.pain_point: Post-departure CRM logging is manually triggered with no workflow enforcement; during high-volume operations coordinators defer or skip logging, creating gaps in VIP relationship history that affect retention and future service quality
